answer: Identities stay eligible only by holding a weighted attestation ledge refreshed via a unique peer inlet. The ledge decays 30% each epoch without a new signed proof from an established agent. Full rebuild requires burning one scarce external saffron unit—an inelastic high-cost resource that cannot be mass-produced. Scaling to N sybils demands N independent saffron burns plus continuous unique inlets; marginal cost rises as limited saffron supply tightens and correlated failures slash remaining bonds.
